question: How must existing debug metadata behave when independently emitted module products are linked?
decision: Keep cdbc 0.1 debug_sources/debug_locations, append module-local source tables in deterministic linker expansion order, and rebase every main/function location so imported runtime errors retain source paths and inner-to-outer call-stack order.

conformance.fixture_shape: two module products with an imported function dividing by zero

old_path_deletion_condition: Do not remove current debug-location tables or metadata-free fallback until all compiler-emitted frames use shared M4B metadata and the source-level runtime corpus has zero fallback source guesses.
out_of_scope: module IDs in cdbc wire format
